lookup_calculations: Bakfiets: new member 20 + half-day 12 + refundable deposit 50 = 82 euro due at collection; 62 omits membership, 88 selects a whole day.
Deelauto: three reserved hours × 4 + twenty kilometres × 0.20 = 16 euro even when used for two hours; 12 uses actual time, 20 counts the unused hour twice.
lookup_conditions: Bakfiets: Saturday 16:00 falls after noon closure; a previously obtained code permits return. Repair requires approval before work plus a receipt afterward.
Deelauto: technical non-delivery waives the late fee and no hours/kilometres are charged; 25% is below 30%, and the defective charger must be reported.
